description: fz-go4.18.12 finding 2. MaterializedExecutable is produced 2x per executable on ALL fixtures; diffing a re-production pair shows the FIRST is under-filled (empty input/value transport positions) and discarded — an artifact pulled before its demand inputs settle, then rebuilt. FIX direction: order/gate the artifact pull so materialization happens once, after the demand it reads has settled (or make the first production wait rather than produce a placeholder). Interacts with finding 1 (the wipe cascade) — fix 1 first and re-measure; this may partially collapse. ACCEPTANCE: MaterializedExecutable produced 1x per executable on the 4-fixture corpus (unless a genuine input revision requires re-materialization, which must be justified by a changed payload); suite green 3x.
title: First MaterializedExecutable production is a discarded under-filled placeholder (2x per executable)
